editorial_still_life.prompt:
Create a premium editorial perfume campaign photograph for "Rogue Princess (BAC)".

MAIN PRODUCT:
Use the exact perfume bottle from the reference image:
../../../../../references/bottles/male/bottle-black-cap.png

PRODUCT RULES:
The perfume bottle is the main protagonist and must remain fully visible.
Preserve: exact bottle design, shape, proportions, cap, label, material, overall product identity.
Must not be covered: true.
Must not be distorted: true.
Must not be duplicated: true.

SCENE:
A premium oriental cedar still life in which the vertically stable bottle stands on a realistic dark cedar-and-stone surface, surrounded by grouped saffron, jasmine, ambergris and fir elements in carefully layered depth.

ENVIRONMENT:
A realistic matte charcoal stone slab with a warm cedar platform supports the completely vertical bottle. Compact ingredient groupings build foreground, midground and background depth: cedar pieces and shavings nearest the camera, ambergris and saffron around the bottle, jasmine and fir receding toward a softly textured dark wall with restrained amber haze.

VISUAL ELEMENTS:
one fully visible reference perfume bottle, completely vertical and physically supported, several realistic cedar blocks, bark fragments and thin shavings, small grouped saffron threads in crimson and gold, a moderate compact group of white jasmine blossoms, several small irregular ambergris fragments, short fir sprigs with detailed needles, dark matte stone slab, subtle translucent amber haze in the background

VISUAL IDENTITY:
The Saffron Cedar Veil: an elegant oriental chamber where luminous saffron, white jasmine, mineral ambergris, cool fir and dry cedar create a mysterious warm-to-cool olfactive transition.

MOOD:
mysterious, oriental, sensual, refined, warm, architectural, luxurious

PALETTE:
deep cedar brown, charcoal black, burnished amber, saffron gold, oxblood red, ivory white, muted fir green

MATERIALS:
matte charcoal stone, dry cedar wood, cedar bark, fine wood shavings, saffron filaments, natural jasmine petals, weathered ambergris texture, fir needles, soft atmospheric haze

LIGHTING:
large soft key light from upper left, gentle warm rim light from rear right and controlled low fill from the front.
Contrast: medium-high with rich shadows and clear reflective detail on the bottle, never crushing the label.

TYPOGRAPHY:
Use the following campaign-specific information in the negative space:
"Rogue Princess (BAC) | Elegancia que deja estela | Perfume nicho amaderado unisex | NOTAS DE SALIDA: Azafran, Jazmin | NOTAS DE CORAZÓN: Ámbar gris | NOTAS DE FONDO: Abeto, Cedro"

FIXED CAMPAIGN RULES:
- The bottle is physically supported by a realistic surface.
- The bottle is completely vertical and stable; it never floats or tilts.
- Use clear foreground, midground and background depth.
- Create richness through quantity, grouping, overlap, layers and texture, not oversized ingredients.
- Keep generous negative space for Spanish typography.
- Typography must never cover the bottle and must remain legible.
- The bottle has the highest visual priority.

CAMPAIGN CONTINUITY:
Both images must share: same perfume identity, same olfactive story, same core visual elements, same color family, same emotional atmosphere.

PHYSICAL SCALE:
Use the perfume bottle as the physical scale reference for the entire scene.
Bottle dimensions: 19 cm high x 3.5 cm wide x 3.5 cm deep.
Every surrounding ingredient and environmental object must have realistic physical proportions relative to the perfume bottle.
Do not create abundance by artificially enlarging ingredients.

CAMERA:
50mm lens, medium shallow depth of field, focus on the perfume bottle, horizontal composition, 5:4 aspect ratio.

PHOTOREALISM:
extreme photorealism. photorealistic materials, realistic lighting, realistic shadows, realistic reflections, realistic glass, realistic botanical textures, realistic physical proportions, realistic atmospheric effects, no illustration, no cartoon, no obvious CGI, no generic stock photography.

DO NOT INCLUDE:
no people, no hands, no extra perfume bottles, no extra products, no distorted bottle, no duplicated bottle, no malformed bottle, no covered bottle, no oversized ingredients, no giant fruits, no giant flowers, no unrealistic ingredient proportions, no ingredient clutter.
